## Shared scenes

> Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly driving away from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) dressed in his best clothes. Intrigued, she walks over to visit [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to find out where he went. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to the station to collect an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) whom they are adopting, leaving Mrs. [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) thoroughly shocked and skeptical about the decision.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but learns from the stationmaster that a young girl was dropped off instead. He meets the talkative young orphan and decides to bring her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to handle the mistake, enjoying her lively chatter along the drive.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

> Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and makes blunt, critical remarks about Anne's red hair and appearance. In a fit of fury, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explodes at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), insulting her back before fleeing to her bedroom. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gently reprimands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, ordering her to stay there until she agrees to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her room. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees, informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they walk over to Mrs. Lynde's house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatically thorough apology. Touched by Anne's performance, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) forgives her and gives her hope about her hair color, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) both relieved and amused as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, which disappoints [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) because none of them feature puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her plain hat with wild flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of Sunday school, criticizing the dry lesson and long sermon while confessing her envy of the other girls' puffed sleeves.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after playing late and excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her attend and promises to bake a basket of food for her, which leads [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to impulsively embrace and kiss her. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits down to do her patchwork sewing, she chatterboxingly describes her imaginative games with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her obsession with the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her prized amethyst brooch.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

> Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard and later forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to vow never to return to school. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to go back, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to seek advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imaginary future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her, bringing rare laughter to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) permits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for an afternoon tea party and tells her she can serve a leftover bottle of raspberry cordial. During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The next day, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally jumping on Diana's formidable [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who is enraged. Learning from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her in the spare-room bed. Anne's candid apology and imaginative conversation charm the old lady, prompting her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and become close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from her last day of school crying over Mr. Phillips's departure, despite her mixed feelings about him, and reports meeting Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She later discusses the new minister with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), falls in love with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) as her new Sunday school teacher, and eagerly prepares to host the couple for tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). After preparing a layer cake and decorating the table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) watches in anticipation as Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) take their first bite of the cake, only for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to react in shock.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the post office ecstatic about being invited to tea at the manse by Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). After worrying overnight that bad weather might ruin her day, she enjoys a wonderful afternoon at the manse and later recounts the details of her visit to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly becomes devoted to her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically describes school activities to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including field afternoons and composition assignments. When Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) announces a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) busies herself with rehearsals despite Marilla's skepticism and finds comfort in Matthew's quiet encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) notices that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses much more plainly than her peers and decides to buy her a pretty dress for Christmas. After a flustered encounter with a shop clerk, he enlists Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to help select and sew a modern dress with puffed sleeves. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), making her performance at the school concert an absolute success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for Christmas. The local Christmas concert is a tremendous success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivering outstanding recitations and earning high praise. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's growth and secretly express their deep pride in her performance and future potential.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Lover's Lane to share the news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) has invited them to stay at her town home for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting Marilla's permission, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) with Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), stay at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), and enjoy several days visiting the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), taking a drive in the park, and attending a concert. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects happily on her wonderful trip and how good it is to be going back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain fierce academic rivals as the school year ends. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to put away her textbooks for a restful summer. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns of Matthew's poor health, and admits to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown up.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a carefree summer outdoors on a doctor's recommendation before resuming her studies in September. Over the course of the school year, she prepares for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination under Miss Stacy's guidance and notices her own personal growth. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect on how tall and mature [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) struggles with her anxieties about passing the upcoming exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates travel to town to take the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) under Miss Stacy's guidance. After three nerve-wracking weeks of waiting back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire island with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends the day expressing deep gratitude for her success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After a celebratory commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Soon after, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) notices Matthew's failing health, learns from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about their savings being tied up in a shaky bank, and shares a quiet, peaceful evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses from sudden heart failure caused by shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank's collapse, and dies instantly. Household members and community neighbors gather to mourn him, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) try to comfort each other through their profound grief. In the following days, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confides her feelings to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and later shares a quiet evening conversation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that she must give up reading and sewing to save her failing eyesight, leading her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to give up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and teach at the local school. After learning that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her benefit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconciles with him, and they agree to become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road
